name: The Pink Answer 2
source:
The story of The Pink Answer 2 picks up exactly at the end of the first game.
You are an agent working for “The Pink Answer,” an organization dedicated to taking out the undiserable parts of society and transforming them into beautiful and obidient transwomen to serve and satisfy a very exclusive clientele.
Thanks to the resounding success with your first patient, you have been promoted and assigned a new patient.
This is a game heavily focused on forced sissyfication, forced feminization, and transformation through the magic of the “Fempils,” a drug that will (under very specific circumstances; that’s where the player comes in) gradually transform a male into a sissy transwoman.
translation:
《The Pink Answer 2》的故事恰好在第一款游戏的结尾处展开。
你是“The Pink Answer”的一名代理人，该组织致力于剔除社会中不可分割的部分，并将她们转变为美丽而听话的跨性别女性，以服务和满足非常独特的客户。
由于你的第一位患者取得了巨大成功，你已被晋升并分配了一名新患者。
这是一款主要关注强制娘娘腔化、强制女性化以及通过“Fempils”魔法进行转变的游戏，这种药物会（在非常特殊的情况下；这就是玩家的用武之地）逐渐将男性转变为娘娘腔的跨性别女性。
